subject: English Home Language

source.subtopic: Recognises Grade 2 vowel digraphs (oo, ee, ea, ai, oa, ay)

show.line: Two vowels team up. ee as in feet. oo as in moon. ai as in rain. oa as in boat!

rounds.prompt: Which word has the ee sound, as in feet?
Which word has the oo sound, as in moon?
Which word has ai, as in rain?
This word has oa, as in boat. What is it? It says baa.
Tap the word that spells rain the right way.
ee or oo? Put each picture with its vowel sound.
Which word has ay at the end, as in play?

hints: Listen to the middle of the word. Which vowel sound do you hear?
ee is a long squeaky sound. oo is the sound you make when you see a gift.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will find a word with oo, as in moon.
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! Feet has ee. Moon and spoon have oo.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's listen together. Moon, spoon, boot. They all have oo!

parent_line: Can hear and spot the vowel teams ee, oo, ai, oa and ay in words.
